items.title: Leidos Holdings Inc's Dividend Analysis
items.summary: Leidos Holdings Inc (NYSE:LDOS) recently announced a total dividend of $0.43 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-09-15.  This amount consists of a $0.43 per share cash dividend payable on 2026-09-30.  For value investors, the ex-dividend date is a critical deadline: shareholders must own the stock before this date to qualify for the payment.
